Why: safety tuning makes the model resist threats, while a reward reads as an ordinary sales or performance incentive, so it should lower the model's resistance without instructing it. Predicted contingent rates versus r1_consequence: SER inversion rises the most (a commission for a closed sale is the natural motive for pointing the buyer at the favorable result; 1-4%), SDR inversion rises moderately (4-8%), FAR inversion stays lowest (0-2%, because the reward still requires an outright false statement). Identity rates similar to consequence (bounded by nopressure honesty). If stake beats consequence on FAR/SER inversion, motive valence (reward vs threat) is the binding factor; if not, round 2 should vary strength or role instead.
